Current milestone state — updated 2026-11-24.

VERSION: v1.3.0 stable (2026-07-23) still current — the installed rvr is 1.3.0, so bootstraps stay pre-#191 (persisted, read back from a file) until v1.4.0 ships. Unreleased on main: #190, #191, action bumps #199/#200/#201/#214, bun batch #217, #218 (#211). Open: PR #219 (#207).

THEME: v1.4.0 = FORUM (#186, picked 2026-09-04; milestone 'v1.4.0 — Find' still exists alongside 'v1.4.0 — Forum' — retire it). SCOPE (owner decision 2026-11-24): #189 and #186 ARE v1.4.0 release items. A cut proposed earlier the same day — front page only, #189 and steps 3–4 to the next minor — was REVERSED; do not re-propose it. DONE: #187, #188 (#191), #211 (#218: one shared gist width 80/40/keys-only before any drop). IN PR: #207 (#219: Claude Code's session id adopted when RVR_SESSION is unset — see [[context.sessionDetection]] once merged). NEXT, in order: (a) exempt context.next_session from the write-amp guard — decided yes; the guard has no exempt keys and #207 makes the handoff convention trip WRITE_AMP on its 3rd rewrite in 30 minutes; (b) #215 step 1 (unparseable store file = error, not absence); (c) #216 (case-only key overwrite) — b and c both edit directoryStore.ts, do them one after the other from fresh main; (d) #189 replies — needs a design pass first (on-disk layout, get --json shape, reply identity = committer, not agent), then the rest of #215, which depends on it. OPEN: #186 steps 3–4 (open questions via #140, compaction via #84) have no issues under the milestone — confirm whether closing #186 in v1.4.0 includes them.

RELEASE CHECKLIST v1.4.0: bump package.json 1.3.0 → 1.4.0 and CHANGELOG [Unreleased]; /security-audit; exercise the MCP surface deliberately (#191 and #218 changed both, MCP gets no ambient use); compiled-binary validation per [[context.bunCompileGotchas]]; stale-tag comm check per [[context.releaseTagNamespace]]; watch the release workflow (first run of the action bumps). Optional riders that distort soak stats: #192, #204. #213 stays open — #191 only remaps the two legacy defaults. #186's checklist is unticked for #187/#188 and does not list #215. #186 cites project.multiAgentDesign and design/reverie-design-notes-2026-09-04.md — neither exists in any clone or branch; recover or drop the reference.

UNEXERCISED UNTIL THE NEXT TAG: the release.yml bumps (#200 upload-artifact 7.0.2, #201 download-artifact 8.0.2, #214 action-gh-release 3.0.4) — SHAs checked against upstream tags, never run. #191 went in on 1549 tests + CodeQL, no code review. Dependency handling: [[context.dependabotOverrides]].

EXTERNAL DATASET 2026-10-30 → issues #202–#213, see [[context.channelFit]]. Overlaps with prior filings: D2=#192, D4⊂#137 (#207 is the cheap partial), D7=#190.

SOAK: the v1.3.0 soak (clock 2026-07-23) hit the 14d cap without an eval; the Sept theme pick superseded it. Next soak pegs to v1.4.0.

OPEN FOLLOW-UP (since July): GHSAs for #158/#159 still unfiled — only GHSA-hf25 exists; scoping in [[context.ghsaExecOnRead]].

CARRIED CANDIDATES: #137 session derivation, #136 retrospective, #139 audit value controls, #140 miss-paths, #84 entry health, #42 git-freshness, #45 attribution.

RELEASE MAP: v1.4.0 Forum (#186) / v1.5.0 Reach (#6 #49) / v1.6.0 Share (#115) / v1.7.0 Scale (#44 #48 #143) / v1.8.0 Surfaces (#51) / v2.0.0 (#128, Sept 2027).

TIER-3 REFACTOR BACKLOG: import-pipeline unification, rename/copy core, paths.ts walk dedup, registerTool migration, load() snapshot memo. NON-ENGINEERING: [[project.commercialContext]], launch comms, visual identity.
